scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently --kill-others --names shared,server,client "npm run dev --workspace=shared" "npm run dev --workspace=server" "npm run dev --workspace=client"
scripts.dev:backend: npm run build:shared && concurrently --kill-others --names shared,server "npm run dev --workspace=shared" "npm run dev --workspace=server"
scripts.dev:frontend: npm run build:shared && concurrently --kill-others --names shared,client "npm run dev --workspace=shared" "npm run dev --workspace=client -- --host"
scripts.build:client: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=client
scripts.build:server: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=server
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=client && npm run build --workspace=server
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test:server && npm run test:client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces
